execution_notes.how_to_run:
For each batch in priority order, use the pixellab-scaled-asset-generation skill. Each batch has a character/building/effect description, action/direction matrix, and a path template for output. The skill's create_character/create_map_object/create_character_animation tools map to these use cases:
  - Characters (batch 1, 2) → create_character_animation for each (action, direction) pair
  - Buildings (batch 3) → create_map_object for each (building, direction) single-frame
  - Props (batch 4) → create_map_object with animated frames for each prop
  - Tiles (batch 5) → create_map_object animation per tile per biome
  - VFX (batch 6) → create_map_object or create_character_animation depending on directionality
execution_notes.post_generation:
After each batch completes:
  1. Update the relevant manifest .mjs file to export the new frames in the standard direction-keyed structure
  2. Run npm test to confirm no breakage
  3. Wire into sprite-pipeline.mjs / combat-sprite-bridge.mjs / heroRotationSprite() / drawParticles() as appropriate
  4. Commit batch-by-batch so any failure is recoverable
